Hana V.: Quick one  I might end the year with ~58h PTO and need to fly home Jan 3 for a family emergency. How much can I carry and is there any fast-track for exceptions since travel is urgent?
Maya (People Ops): Hi Hana  standard FT carryover cap is 40 hours and carried hours must be used by Mar 31. For emergency situations we have an expedited exception process: manager note + a short email to people-ops@redwood.com with subject line 'EXPEDITED PTO CARRY - <Name>'. We prioritize those within 48 hours.
Leo B.: If the exception is approved, does Rippling update immediately?
Maya (People Ops): We update balances manually as soon as payroll confirms the adjustment; that generally takes 1-2 business days after approval. We also notify your manager and payroll.
Hana V.: Is there ever a payout option instead of carrying?
Maya (People Ops): We do offer a one-time carry-to-cash option for up to 40h if requested during year-end processing, but it requires manager sign-off and must follow payroll cutoffs. For emergencies we prefer carry or expedited extension; payout requests take longer.
Carlos (Manager): From a coverage perspective, if Hana needs the days during the soft blackout period, we can swap shifts with Leo. Hana, please confirm dates and Ill document coverage in the headcount notes.
Leo B.: Also note we have a 'holiday swap' sheet for teams to trade on-call/coverage days. Managers verify swaps by Dec 10.
Hana V.: Thanks  would the expedited exception still apply if I'm currently on an international assignment? My payroll is local EU.
Maya (People Ops): For international assignees we follow local law if it provides greater protection. If local law prevents carryover, payroll/legal will advise. Otherwise the expedited exception still applies, but payroll may need more time for cross-border updates.
Hana V.: If the emergency means I need to take sick instead of PTO for the first two days, do sick hours affect carryover?
Maya (People Ops): Sick bank does not carry over; it resets per policy. If you use sick for the immediate emergency, that won't reduce your PTO carry cap. Good practice: put the first days as sick and the remainder as PTO in Rippling, then we can process the carry exception for leftover PTO.
Leo B.: What if someone on the rota refuses a swap and it blocks coverage during mandatory rota days?
Maya (People Ops): Mandatory rota roles are set by managers. If a swap can't be found and the absence is urgent/emergency, escalate to the director and people-ops will work to find temporary coverage or approve an exception. We try to avoid forcing people, but critical infra coverage is prioritized.
Hana V.: Can you paste the short expedited email template?
Maya (People Ops): Sure  copy/paste: 'Subject: EXPEDITED PTO CARRY - Hana V.
Hi People Ops,
I request expedited approval to carry 18 additional PTO hours (total carry 58h) due to family emergency requiring travel Jan 3. Manager: Carlos (attached). Requested use-by: 2026-03-31. Please advise on timeline.
Thanks,
Hana'
